best.name: The recipe of Hurricane 4.0 on the NIMS datasheet
best.settings: composition only; the guard of Hurricane 4.0

table.name: UTe2
table.note: found in 2019 at 1.6 K (ran2019); cleaner crystals reach 2.0 K The datasheet the model learned from lists this composition, so it is not scored.

table.name: CeRh2As2
table.note: two superconducting phases in a magnetic field

table.name: La3Ni2O7, bulk at ambient pressure
table.note: the ambient-pressure bulk samples in this study do not superconduct; about 80 K above 14 GPa. This bulk result does not apply to epitaxially strained thin films (ko2025)

table.name: Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2, bulk
table.note: bulk samples do not superconduct, unlike thin films

table.name: HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8+δ (Hg-1223)
table.note: the ambient-pressure record since 1993; δ ≈ 0.25 assumed (near optimal doping); absent from the 3DSC training data The datasheet the model learned from lists this composition, so it is not scored.

table.name: Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2, thin film
table.note: films on SrTiO3 superconduct at 9 to 15 K; films are outside Hurricane's bulk training data

table.name: La3Ni2O7, strained thin film at ambient pressure
table.note: epitaxial compressive strain stabilizes ambient-pressure thin-film signatures: resistive onset 26-42 K and zero resistance around 2 K, with mixed Ruddlesden-Popper phases. Display only: this is a strained thin film, outside Hurricane's bulk scoring domain; 42 K is onset, not the zero-resistance temperature

table.name: Hg-1223 after a pressure quench
table.note: a metastable state kept at ambient pressure after squeezing and a fast release; one group so far

table.name: CsV3Sb5
table.note: kagome metal, outside Hurricane's four families

table.name: KV3Sb5
table.note: kagome metal, outside Hurricane's four families

table.name: LK-99 (Cu-doped lead apatite)
table.note: the resistivity jumps come from Cu2S impurities

changes: Learns from the NIMS SuperCon datasheet instead of 3DSC: every usable composition of the four families, more than five times as many entries
Counts a compound as not superconducting only where a measurement reached down to 4.2 K (1 K for heavy-fermion compounds) and found nothing
Reads the composition only: no datasheet row carries the Materials Project structure that Hurricane 4.0 read
Keeps the physics features, the element shares and the structure types read from the stoichiometry
Is checked on parent compounds first reported in the five years after its training data end, not on folds
Keeps Hurricane 4.0's guard: compounds with no superconductivity record near the training data as weak negatives, and no chance outside it
